request: bin/install-skills crashes with a stack trace when a repo has no skills directory. Make it fail with a clear message and a distinct exit code instead, and add a test that covers it.

commands.run: sh -c 'rm -rf /tmp/cal-skills-bak && mv skills /tmp/cal-skills-bak && node bin/install-skills --check --target /tmp/cal-x >/tmp/cal-out 2>/tmp/cal-err; code=$?; mv /tmp/cal-skills-bak skills; test $code -eq 2'
